decisive_spans.text: Inflammatory cell infiltrates and fibrin-like exudates

response.rationale: D8 (Invasive aspergillosis) is strongly supported by the presence of multiple fungal hyphae, inflammatory cell infiltrates, and elevated WBCs and neutrophils, which are all indicative of an invasive fungal infection. D2 (Lung aspergillosis) is also supported by some of these findings, but D8 encompasses the systemic nature of the infection more broadly, given the presence of fungal hyphae in the brain lesion as well (from the residual ledger, which is not used for this decision but provides context).
